q: The court was all astir and a-buzz, when the black sheep—whom many fell away from in dread—pressed him into an obscure corner among the crowd.

e: From a- (“in, on”) + building (“the act or process of building”).
q: This talk brought us up to the house that was a-building, not a large one, which stood at the end of a beautiful orchard surrounded by an old stone wall.
1890, William Morris, chapter XXVI, in News from Nowhere:
